# Check how attr_list stores data-toc-label
import subprocess
result = subprocess.run(
    ['python', '-c', r'''
import markdown

md_text = """[TOC]

# Foo & Bar { data-toc-label="Custom & Label" }
"""
md = markdown.Markdown(extensions=["toc", "attr_list"])

# Patch TocTreeprocessor.run to see raw_label before processing
original_run = md.treeprocessors['toc'].run

def debug_run(doc):
    for el in doc.iter():
        if isinstance(el.tag, str) and el.tag.startswith('h'):
            raw_label = el.attrib.get('data-toc-label')
            print(f"raw_label repr: {repr(raw_label)}")
            print(f"raw_label bytes: {raw_label.encode() if raw_label else None}")
            
            # Check htmlStash
            print(f"htmlStash: {md.htmlStash.rawHtmlBlocks}")
    return original_run(doc)

md.treeprocessors['toc'].run = debug_run

html = md.convert(md_text)
'''],
    capture_output=True, text=True, cwd='.'
)
print("STDOUT:", result.stdout)
if result.stderr:
    print("STDERR:", result.stderr[-500:])
